question: Should OpenClaw’s experimental Claws stack adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical authored and exported package manifest while retaining grouped JSON only as a compatible input format?
rationale: This is a new user-facing package and export contract in core, not a mechanical bug repair; the branch is stacked on unmerged lifecycle work, so maintainer intent must decide whether this format becomes the supported experimental direction.

options.title: Sponsor the CLAW.md contract
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export after current-head lifecycle proof confirms JSON input compatibility and round-trip behavior.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical for now
options.body: Retain the existing JSON export artifact until the broader Claws lifecycle and authoring contract has a maintainer-approved migration direction.

options.title: Pause the experimental stack
options.body: Defer both manifest formats until maintainers decide whether the Claws lifecycle belongs in core and what package contract it should expose.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the CLAW.md contract
recommendation.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export after current-head lifecycle proof confirms JSON input compatibility and round-trip behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed feature-history contact in the supplied unmerged Claws stack; final acceptance still requires a repository maintainer.
